claims.claim_text: Teal Drones was selected in November 2024 as a winner of the U.S. Army Short Range Reconnaissance (SRR) Program of Record. The increase in FY2025 revenue ($40.7M, +128% vs FY2024) is attributable primarily to increased revenue associated with the commencement and scaling of drone deliveries to the U.S. Army under the SRR program.
